title: trajectory sensitivity, robust surrogate, and rank-event stability

environment_note: Apple Silicon CPU, no GPU/MPS/CUDA; deterministic seeded numpy/scipy linear algebra (default_rng seeds 2718/4242/5150/9191)

config.pose_theta_convention: theta = atan2(-p_y, -p_x): body +x axis points toward the origin

seeds.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); directions normalized to unit q-norm

config.randomness_note: family5 is deterministic under fixed numpy default_rng seeds 2718, 4242, 5150, 9191 (recorded per use); dense numpy/scipy linear algebra

part1.grid_note: logspace(-4,-1,9) has no exact 1e-3 node; an explicit on_grid=False row at eps=1e-3 is added for the tolerance gates, while clean-window slopes use only the 9 on-grid samples

clean_window_frozen.selection_rule: fallback: largest 4 samples (no clean positive-slope run)

part2.gate_semantics: P2 pass reflects the well-gapped chosen eigenvalues only (tolerance rows at exact eps=1e-3): rel_full_eig < 1e-3 and rel_frozen_eig > 10x rel_full_eig.  Chosen eigenvalues whose min adjacent gap is < 1e-6 are flagged (gap_flags / simple_condition_flagged_indices) and the simple-eigenvalue condition is reported as invalid there, without being asserted
part2.note: gaps recorded in ascending index convention; gap < 1e-6 invalidates the simple-eigenvalue condition

part3.note: Euclidean pose norm / Euclidean dual; adverse direction -g_r/||g_r||; predicted = lam0 - eps||g_r|| (first order)

part4.empirical_only: L_emp and L_nominal are finite-sample / basis-direction diagnostics only: no uniform operator-Lipschitz constant over the full ball is derived, so no bound here is certified.  The Weyl check is self-consistent by construction on the same samples.

part5.note: eigenvalue gap is not a certified crossing; rank/sigma-min(B) events use the stated machine tolerance / 1e-8 threshold
part5.scan_cluster_note: the minimum adjacent gap along the scan occurs in the numerically-zero eigenvalue cluster (tau* pair magnitudes 8.01e-15 and 1.46e-14, well below sigma_min(A)~1e-8); sigma_min(B) stays ~6e-4..8e-4 and rank(B)=18 throughout

pass_summary.overall_semantics: P1-P4 gates pass on their stated criteria; P2's median choice is flagged as a non-simple eigenvalue (min adjacent gap 5.9e-8 < 1e-6) and is excluded from the P2 gate (see gap_flags); P5 is recorded with no forced pass

scope_note: Finite-dimensional whitened/realified dense linear algebra on the validated Family-1 Jacobians with the shared smooth p=24 basis. Sensitivity and empirical Lipschitz statements are scenario-specific; P4 is explicitly not certified.
